adversarialFindings: CLAIMS RESTING ON SELF-REPORT ONLY (the shape the mandate warned about): every session-START number in the headline table (0.7689%, 89 cells, geometry 141, 14 types, 18 partial cells, 11/14 rails). The ledger endpoint has no history, so NONE of these can be re-derived. The END numbers are all independently verifiable and I verified them; the BEFORE numbers are unfalsifiable by construction. Every delta in the capture inherits that. This is the single largest epistemic weakness in the document and it is invisible because the AFTER column is so well-evidenced.

SPECIFIC INSTANCE OF THE 'TEST ASSERTS THE SAME CONSTANT' PATTERN: the capture's claim 'Rails with writer + atom family 14/14' is verified by a CI test (railEngineBindingCoverage) that S1's own PR body says passes when a rail 'binds an on-disk writer/scorer OR declares noWriterReason'. A rail can therefore satisfy the instrument by declaring it has no writer. The live ledger's hasWriter=true on 3,556/3,556 cannot distinguish the two cases either. So '14/14 rails have a writer' is potentially verified by something structurally incapable of detecting its own falsity — the exact defect class the session catalogued eight times. easement and rrc-pipelines are the named declarers and both sit at 0 satisfied cells.

THE LEDGER IS NOT MOVING. The capture instructs the reader 'Do not reconcile these two readings as an error.' Two live reads ten minutes apart are byte-identical (405 / 12.909486508370861). The parcel-weighting explanation for why % rose while cells fell is CORRECT and I confirm it. But 'A2 mid-run, do not reconcile' is a thought-terminating instruction attached to a settled 18-cell delta. This session already had one silent 1,016-cell regression that read as normal variance; a standing instruction not to reconcile an unexplained cell drop is precisely how the second one gets missed. The 18 cells should be attributed rail-by-rail before this capture is trusted.

DEFECT 4 IS OPEN AND THE DOCUMENT'S STRUCTURE HIDES IT. Listing eight defects under 'the pattern that dominated the session', marking exactly one OPEN, creates a strong reading that seven are closed. symnum.ts still returns 'producing' for every unmatched SYMNUM on origin/main. The capture itself says this would mislabel 'Canceled / Abandoned Location' across 1.4M wells — and the RRC statewide source (1,396,049 wells) is described as newly staged, which means the blast radius went UP this session while the defect stayed open. mapSymnumToWellType has the identical bare `return "oil"` fallthrough, which the capture does not mention at all.

COUNTING-RULE RELAPSE. The capture correctly retires '26 of 47 cad-ingest files' for being quoted without its counting method, states the lesson ALWAYS QUOTE A RATIO WITH ITS COUNTING RULE — and then quotes 'Parcel fabric 253/254' (a staging-table county count) in the same visual column as satisfied-cell ratios, and '12 of 16 families unreachable' without stating that 16 = PROPERTY_ENTITY_TYPES length and 4 = the DID regex alternation. Both happen to be TRUE (I verified both), but they are quoted in the retired style.

WHAT I EXPECTED TO BREAK AND DID NOT — the obvious suspects were again wrong. Criterion 3's absolute zero is REAL and survives the strongest test available: not merely 'no no-writer cells' but no derivation-indeterminate cells either, meaning S1's new third state did not become a hiding place for the old ones. The 16/4/12 atom-type arithmetic is exactly right. Styling centralisation is real and stronger than claimed — render.ts carries an explicit @internal export block of ~25 shared primitives documented as 'shared sheet primitives for sibling assemblers', and dossier.ts and flood-drainage.ts both import from the same template-tokens.ts. The operator's styling red line is genuinely SAFE. Geometry 251/254 is exact, with the 3 misses identified (48129, 48135 at 5%, 48201 Harris). All six hauska-engine PRs are MERGED as described. Factory 1.5 artifacts all exist including the fail-closed sourceTierSatisfied assertions at both TS and SQL layers.

META: the capture is substantially more accurate than the session's track record predicted. The failures are concentrated in (a) unverifiable historical baselines, (b) two stale Open items, (c) one genuinely open defect misfiled as closed, and (d) repo-unqualified PR citations. None of the load-bearing END-STATE measurements were wrong. The document should be corrected, not rewritten.
